Give your cleaning team a clear start

A successful handover is a practical document.

01Assess02Plan03Document
01

Identify the fixtures

Label the model and location in the site register. Keep the current manufacturer’s care instructions available to permanent staff and replacement teams.

02

Agree the routine

Record approved products, responsibilities and where replacement components are kept. Demonstrate the specified method rather than assuming experience with a different fixture transfers directly.

03

Close the reporting loop

Give staff one way to report slow drainage, damage or persistent odour. Include the fixture location, observation date and last recorded service so the responsible person can respond.
